KFUPM Business SchoolBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship02
Message from the Dean

Where innovation meets impact

Dr. Turki N. BaroudDean, KFUPM Business School

At KFUPM Business School, we are reimagining business education for a new era defined by innovation, technology, and purpose.

As Saudi Arabia advances toward Vision 2030, KBS is shaping leaders who can bridge business and technology, turning ideas into real-world impact. Our programs empower students to think strategically, act entrepreneurially, and lead responsibly in a fast-changing global economy.

We believe that true business leadership today requires fluency in data, technology, and systems thinking, coupled with a deep sense of purpose and responsibility toward society.

Our faculty combine world-class scholarship with industry engagement, ensuring that every course, project, and partnership connects classroom learning with real business challenges. From digital transformation and sustainability to entrepreneurship and AI, KBS is where innovation meets impact.

Through our global collaborations and deep ties to industry, we are building a learning ecosystem that equips graduates not just to adapt to change but to lead it. KBS will continue to evolve, expanding interdisciplinary programs, advancing impactful research, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset among students and executives alike.

Welcome to KBS, where business, technology, and humanity converge to create the leaders of tomorrow.

Chairman
Dr. Nasser A. Alqahtani
Chairman
Department of Management & Marketing

KFUPM Business School

BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship

Inspiring the next generation of digital ventures

Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship05
Overview
  • Prepares entrepreneurial, tech-enabled professionals to design and scale innovative ventures at the intersection of finance, technology, and digital platforms
  • Integrates finance, computing, AI, cybersecurity, and blockchain to build strong capabilities in developing secure, data-driven, and scalable business solutions
  • Develops understanding of crowd behavior, digital marketing, and new media to help students grow platforms, engage users, and drive adoption in competitive digital markets
  • Equips graduates to launch, manage, and expand fintech and technology ventures by combining analytical thinking, innovation, and venture-building skills
Disciplines and competencies covered
Strategy
Finance
Technology
Crowd/consumer behavior
Entrepreneurship
Quant/analytics/ computing
New media
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship06
Program Learning Outcomes

Learning Objectives

Knowledge and UnderstandingSkillsValues, Autonomy, and Responsibility
01

FinTech and Entrepreneurship Knowledge

The ability to explain FinTech and entrepreneurship concepts, principles, and theories appropriately

Knowledge and Understanding
Discuss core fintech technologies and digital financial systems, including payment systems, digital banking, blockchain, and data-driven financial services.
Explain entrepreneurial concepts, business frameworks, and steps to start fintech and financial ventures using technology.
02

FinTech for Entrepreneurs

The ability to explain, analyze, and utilize financial technologies, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to support financial innovation and entrepreneurial activities

Knowledge and Understanding
Describe the roles, functions, and applications of financial technologies (FinTech), digital financial platforms, and AI-enabled tools used in modern financial systems and entrepreneurial ventures.
Skills
Analyze financial data and utilize FinTech platforms, digital financial tools, and AI-enabled systems to support financial analysis, digital financial services, and entrepreneurial decision-making.
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship07
Program Learning Outcomes · BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship
03

Entrepreneurial Leadership and Teamwork Abilities

The ability to become entrepreneurial leaders who can use FinTech to drive positive change and innovation in teams and communicate effectively

Knowledge and Understanding
Explain leadership principles and frameworks for entrepreneurs
Skills
Communicate entrepreneurial ideas and opportunities in developing FinTech solutions effectively.
Work effectively in a collaborative and inclusive teams to achieve common entrepreneurial and FinTech goals.
04

Entrepreneurship Decision-Making Abilities in FinTech

The ability to make entrepreneurial FinTech decisions in ethical and sustainable manners

Knowledge and Understanding
Discuss entrepreneurial decision-making frameworks and analytical approaches used in FinTech contexts.
Skills
Apply structured entrepreneurial problem-solving techniques to evaluate FinTech decisions that consider immediate and long-term
Values, Autonomy, and Responsibility
Students will be able to identify ethical, governance, and sustainability issues in FinTech decisions.
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship08
BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship

Inspiring the next generation of digital ventures

  • Combines fintech, entrepreneurship, AI, blockchain, cybersecurity, and venture-building into a single program designed around creating and leading digital ventures
  • Develops understanding of crowd behavior, digital marketing, and new media to help grow platforms, engage users, and drive adoption in competitive digital markets
  • Equips graduates for fast-growing sectors such as digital payments, fintech platforms, product growth, and startup innovation
Career pathways
Fintech startupsFintech productsCustomer successQuantitative analysisFintech complianceBlockchainEntrepreneurship

BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship

Career Prospects

01Fintech Startup Founder / Entrepreneur

Validates problem-solution fit, raises capital, and executes go-to-market

02Fintech Product Specialist/ Manager

Designs and leads development of digital financial products

03Fintech Analyst

Evaluates fintech deals, markets, and business models

04Customer Success Manager (B2B FinTech)

Drives adoption and retention for fintech platforms

05Quantitative Analyst (Quant)

Uses statistical models to optimize trading and assess risk

06Fintech Compliance Officer

Ensures adherence to AML/KYC and data security standards

07AI/ML Engineer in Finance

Builds AI models for fraud prevention and customer behavior

08Blockchain Developer/ Architect

Builds smart contracts and secure transaction platforms

NewCore
FINT 230

Introduction to FinTech

Pre-requisiteBUS 200Topics10
  • Key drivers of digital transformation in financial services
  • Speed and settlement delays
  • Digital payments and alternative finance
  • Platform-based and ecosystem-driven models
  • Peer-to-peer lending and crowdfunding
  • Embedded finance and platform integration
  • BigTech vs. traditional financial institutions
  • Open banking and API ecosystems
  • User-centric design in financial services
  • FinTech Platforms and System Architecture
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship15
BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
FINT 330

FinTech Regulation and Compliance

Pre-requisiteFINT 230Topics10
  • Consumer protection, market integrity, and fin. stability
  • Regulatory institutions and frameworks
  • Payment systems regulation
  • Electronic money and digital wallets
  • Cross-border payment oversight
  • Disclosure, credit risk, and consumer protection
  • Licensing and prudential requirements
  • Legal classification of crypto assets
  • Technology-driven systemic vulnerabilities
  • Ethical considerations and responsible AI in Finance

FINT 350

Decentralized Finance, Blockchain & FinTech Platforms

Pre-requisiteFINT 230Topics11
  • Cryptographic Foundations
  • Bitcoin Architecture and Monetary Design
  • Ethereum and Smart Contracts
  • Scalability and the Blockchain Trilemma
  • Crypto-Economic Incentives and Tokenomics
  • Decentralized Exchanges and Automated Market Makers
  • Decentralized Lending and Borrowing Protocols
  • Stablecoins and Asset Tokenization

BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
FINT 340

Financial Modeling & Simulation

Pre-requisiteFIN 320, BAI 221Topics9
  • Data collection, cleaning, storage, and management of textual and financial data
  • Collecting textual data from financial newspapers and social media
  • Web scraping and API-based data extraction
  • Text pre-processing: stop words, stemming, lemmatisation
  • Feature engineering and text representation techniques
  • Applications in trading, portfolio management, and risk modelling
  • Big data applications in FinTech
  • Integrating textual and numerical data for improved decision-making
  • Social media analytics for asset management
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship18

NewCore
FINT 430

Behavioral Finance

Pre-requisiteFIN 320Topics10
  • Foundations of Behavioural Decision-Making
  • Investor Behaviour in Digital Trading Environments
  • Herding, Market Sentiment, and Information Diffusion
  • Behavioural Aspects of Cryptocurrencies and Digital Assets
  • Algorithmic Trading and Automation in Financial Markets
  • Behavioural Asset Pricing in Technology-Driven Markets
  • AI, Big Data, and Behavioural Insights
  • Measuring sentiment in financial news and social media
  • Using sentiment indicators for asset pricing and investment decisions
  • Forecasting asset prices and returns

NewCore
ENTR 250

Lean Startup: Crowdsourcing & Business Model Design

Pre-requisiteBUS 200Topics11
  • Ideation & Opportunity Recognition (Brainstorming and AI-assisted)
  • Crowdsourcing for ideation and opportunity discovery
  • Feasibility & Data-Driven Analysis
  • The Assumption Map (Deconstructing a business model into testable hypotheses)
  • Customer Discovery & Market Segmentation
  • Hypothesis Testing & Validation
  • Business Model Canvas
  • Entrepreneurial Strategy (Competitive positioning and the “Why Now” logic)
  • Minimum Viable Product (MVP) Architecture & Unit Economics
  • Product-Market Fit (PMF)
  • Metrics & Growth Accounting

BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
BAI 404

Cybersecurity in Business

Pre-requisiteICS 104, BUS 200Topics10
  • Foundational principles of information security and risk management; cybersecurity concepts and terminologies
  • Human behavior, organizational processes, and technological factors shaping cyber risk
  • Security governance, policy development, and organizational security architecture
  • Operational readiness, business continuity planning, incident detection, response, & recovery
  • Legal and ethical considerations in privacy, data protection, and intellectual property
  • Data governance and breach management; cybersecurity intelligence and risk communication
  • Security awareness, training, and cyber culture development
  • Financial, legal, and operational implications of cyber threats
  • Cybersecurity challenges in fintech ventures and digital platforms
  • Impact of emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, IoT, cloud computing, and quantum cryptography on supply chains and markets
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship21
BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
ENTR 310

Start-up Financing, Venture Capitals and Exits Strategies

Pre-requisiteBUS 200Topics9
  • Foundational Venture Finance (Financial projections, unit economics, and burn rate modelling)
  • The VC Ecosystem & Fund Mechanics
  • Startup Valuation
  • Equity Engineering (Term sheet negotiations, deal structuring, and Cap Table simulation)
  • Alternative Financing (Using SAFEs, venture debt, and crowdfunding)
  • Fintech Capital Strategy
  • Strategic Exits (Navigating M&A, Private Equity buy-outs, and the IPO journey)
  • Governance, Board Management, and “Founder Vesting”
  • Due Diligence Readiness & Data Room Management
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship22
BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
ENTR 320

Product & Growth Strategy

Pre-requisiteBUS 200Topics9
  • Product Strategy (build a vision, positioning, and strategic narrative)
  • Product Roadmap & Prioritization
  • Monetization & Pricing Strategy
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) Execution
  • Growth Engines (Product-Led Growth, growth hacking, & Viral Loops)
  • Platform Dynamics & Network Effects
  • Innovation strategy (Platform and ecosystem growth)
  • Retention & Lifecycle Marketing (Behavioral economics, churn reduction, customer retention, and LTV optimization)
  • Defensibility & Moats (Strategic positioning for long-term market dominance)
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship23
BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
ENTR 410

Case Studies in FinTech & Venture Creation

Pre-requisiteENTR 250Topics6
  • Analysing real startup cases to help formulate entrepreneurial strategy.
  • Analysing real startup cases to understand how founders: make high-stakes choices under uncertainty; evaluate customer needs, competitive dynamics, pricing and unit economics; make go-to-market strategies, team challenges, financing options, and pivot decisions; identify pain points in finance and validate whether the problem is real, urgent, and worth solving; and Attract customers when trust is fragile
  • Analysing cases on venture capital valuation, raising capital with limited traction, narrative building, and establishing credibility in pitching
  • Analysing cases involving ethics, risk management, fraud spikes, outages, breaches, and incident response; how leaders balance speed, cost, and resilience.
  • Identifying pain points in legacy finance and validating whether a software or technological solution is real, urgent, and worth solving.
  • Examining FinTech technologies and applications in payments, lending, banking, insurance, and investment services.
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship24
BS Fintech and Entrepreneurship new course descriptions
NewCore
ENTR 420

Venture Launch Innovation Lab

Pre-requisiteENTR 250, Senior StandingTopics8
  • Solution-Space Exploration (Converting validated problems into tech/Fintech solutions).
  • Product Architecture & Rapid Prototyping (UX/UI design, MVP scoping)
  • Hands on analysis of how the product will delight users, be hard to copy, and enhance margins.
  • The North Star Roadmap (Setting growth metrics and milestones)
  • Growth & Distribution (hands on growth hacking, and customer acquisition strategy)
  • Trust Design & Compliance (Building secure, compliant, and transparent user journeys)
  • Launch & Investor Readiness (Traction metrics and the final venture pitch)
  • Innovation Capstone (Practical application of all phases to a live prototype/MVP)
Source: KBSBS Fintech & Entrepreneurship25
